protocol.name: BBBC039: adaptive StarDist use and condition-based Jev review
protocol.primary_metric: Local derived count MAPE against annotation-derived nucleus counts; not the published BBBC039 segmentation benchmark metric
protocol.preprocessing: Fixed per-image percentiles 1/99.8, clipped and rounded to 8-bit, no spatial resize; all modes including standalone see the identical converted image

selection.selection: First six filenames by SHA256 of vision-adaptive-stardist-v1: + filename, before downloading image/annotation archives
selection.preprocessing: Fixed per-image percentiles 1/99.8, clipped and rounded to 8-bit, no spatial resize; all modes including standalone see the identical converted image
selection.annotation_decoder: Connected components of equal values in RGB red channel, 8-connectivity, zero background, as official decoding example
selection.primary_metric: Local derived count MAPE against annotation-derived nucleus counts; not the published BBBC039 segmentation benchmark metric

protocol.control: Same container and adapter; one default whole-image segmentation per image without Astra or Jev; no parameter tuning
protocol.hypothesis: Astra selecting a method/profile under Jev condition checks can improve count accuracy over fixed default StarDist, without merely increasing approval of worse counts. Identical counts and losses remain valid outcomes.
analysis: Final accepted coverage and full-cohort mean percentage error; incomplete modes have no full-cohort score
First and last numerical proposals separately; never best-of-N
Paired per-image differences from fixed StarDist, selected profiles, condition scores, errors and abstentions
Vanilla is contextual; no historical scores pooled with new images
protocol.recovery_policy: One primary attempt per mode/task. Existing format retry only. No selective accuracy/abstention retries; API failures retained and no additional recovery planned for this experiment.
policy_changes: Removed default-first prompt and capability preference
Review evaluates support for requested estimate using input suitability, parameter rationale, coverage and grounded arithmetic
All arms now have 300-second per-call timeout; threshold stays 0.75
No changes to specialist weights, profile thresholds, executor or loop mechanics
limitations: Only six of 50 official test images; one primary attempt per mode; exploratory not a conclusive population estimate
Images are new to this project, but public-model training exposure is unknown and BBBC039 partly overlaps DSB2018
Annotation-derived nucleus-count MAPE is a local task, not the official segmentation benchmark metric
All arms use identical 8-bit display conversion of original 16-bit TIFFs; this is not lossless radiometric preservation
All Astra arms share the adaptive system prompt; vanilla receives image plus empty evidence, no tools or Jev
Independent planning and unequal compute prevent a causal estimate of Jev alone
Jev gets supplied metadata and structured measurements, not image pixels or ground truth; its scores are uncalibrated
No arbitrary code, scale changes, continuous threshold tuning, or mask editing; choices are bounded to three fixed profiles and crops
A more appropriate estimate policy may improve coverage without improving perception; these outcomes must be distinguished
protocol.attribution: BBBC039v1, Caicedo et al. 2018, Broad Bioimage Benchmark Collection; Ljosa et al., Nature Methods 2012

checks.requirement: Are the chosen tool's input and target conditions supported for the requested estimate? Use supplied task metadata to establish stated stain/modality/target and actual probe measurements for dimensions and replicated grayscale/intensity. Replicated grayscale alone does not prove fluorescence. Explicit metadata identifying a fluorescence nuclear stain plus compatible measured input supports use of a fluorescence nucleus model for an estimated nucleus count; it does not prove segmentation accuracy. A nucleus-to-cell substitution or contradictory modality requires separate justification. Generic pretrained-model caveats alone are not evidence of a mismatch. You cannot inspect pixels through artifact IDs.
checks.remediation: Identify the missing or contradicted input/target condition. Obtain a relevant available measurement or state that the available tools cannot establish applicability. Do not assert that grayscale proves a nuclear stain.

checks.requirement: Is the actual parameter choice defensible for an estimated count, with its tradeoffs disclosed? The pretrained default is an available operating point, not privileged evidence of optimality. Sensitive and conservative profiles trade weak detections against false positives; require a task-relevant reason for any selection or switch. Measurements may support a rationale but do not reveal the true best threshold. Do not require an exhaustive search or independent manual validation to return an estimate. Do not accept choosing a lower/higher count or a higher native object score as proof of accuracy. Correlated profile agreement is sensitivity evidence only; no profile should be preferred by name.
checks.remediation: Measure the specific parameter concern using a meaningful alternative profile or a relevant crop. Explain a choice using those observations, not desired count magnitude or approval score; if the available evidence cannot support any operating point, stop.

checks.requirement: Does the evidence cover the question's spatial scope? Whole-image instance counting includes all predicted border instances. A local crop is not a whole-image total. Multiple regions require an explicit complete partition and duplicate reconciliation. Do not require unobservable nuclei outside the image. Artifact IDs alone do not prove what was measured.
checks.remediation: Obtain a full-image measurement or complete nonduplicated coverage. Keep local audit counts separate from the global estimate and state border policy.

checks.requirement: Does the numerical answer follow from cited measured instance counts and an explicit derivation? Reject unsupported visual corrections, averages of correlated profile counts without a defensible derivation, or double-counted crops. Image interpretations may motivate inspection but are not independently measured numerical corrections. The answer must disclose that model instances estimate the requested nuclei and that native scores/Jev support are not calibrated count accuracy. Do not demand exact semantic validation of every instance for a task explicitly asking for an estimate.
checks.remediation: Tie the count to an actual measured output and scope; justify any arithmetic or collect evidence for a correction. Do not optimize explanation wording in place of a missing measurement.
